icons.name: join-team

Light: the fourth seat slides in to the round table, docks with a hit and a small rebound, and the table pulses once as it lands. Strong: the seat draws back first, drives in harder with two settling swings, the table pulses bigger, and the welcome ripples round the circle: the neighbouring seats open out and back, then the far seat. Ends with the new seat in the ring, as in v1; the preview reset fades it back to the prepared pose.
